items.title: Install CVC Helper Test and check Android updates
instructions: Done: you reported CVC Helper Test 0.4.0 installed. Keep that installation and do not reinstall. 0.4.1 is now published at the same address from the same verified source.

Switch away from the test app (or lock the phone) for a minute, return and time how long until Nuova versione disponibile appears. Type a student-note change and immediately tap Aggiorna; note whether Salvataggio… or Salvato was shown. Check the edit survives and Impostazioni shows 0.4.1.
With enlarged text, check Allievi + and the Equipaggi controls with a person selected while the offer shows. Try Cerca aggiornamenti in airplane mode, then online.
Report D3-PHONE-UPDATE with your device, browser and Android version, both versions, the offer time, the saved edit and reachable controls; follow Updates and versions in docs/DEVICE_CHECKS.md.
items.expected: The 0.4.0 → 0.4.1 update appears within one minute of returning, without reinstalling; the typed edit survives and controls remain reachable. Only your actual phone observations can pass this check.

result.source: Owner chat reports in the Claude Code session of 2026-10-19, ending with the explicit instruction to record D3-PHONE-UPDATE as accepted with the note-edit and larger-text steps listed as not observed.
result.summary: Accepted by the owner with two steps not observed. Observed on the phone: 0.4.0 installed from the test address and kept, no reinstall; after other use, Nuova versione disponibile with Più tardi and Aggiorna appeared within a few seconds of returning (not timed precisely); after Aggiorna the bar said once CVC Helper è aggiornata alla versione 0.4.1, Impostazioni Versione shows 0.4.1, and previously registered students remained. Cerca aggiornamenti said offline in airplane mode and Nessuna versione più recente disponibile ora online. NOT OBSERVED: typing a student-note change and tapping Aggiorna immediately (Salvataggio…/Salvato state and survival of that edit); reachability of Allievi + and Equipaggi controls with enlarged text while the offer showed (owner did not check; said it looked ok).
result.osVersion: Android, version not stated by the owner

items.title: Check course files, persistent storage and full reset on Android
instructions: Open your installed CVC Helper Test (do not reinstall). Switch away and return until Nuova versione disponibile appears, tap Aggiorna, and check Impostazioni shows 0.4.3. Use fictitious people only.

In Impostazioni tap Prepara il file del corso: the check mark and File del corso pronto should appear at once, with Salva file and Condividi in view. Tap Salva file, then Condividi and send the file to another app (it arrives as a .txt). Report the receiving app; any error should show with a red triangle above the bottom bar.
Import the shared or saved file: check the preview, cancel once, then confirm replacement. Reopen and check students, notes, duties and crews.

Confirm Azzera tutti i dati locali. If it takes long, you may close the app: reopening should finish the reset (with a hint after a few seconds) and then open without a course. Confirm the regular CVC Helper app still has its own course.
Report D4-PHONE-TRANSFER with your device, browser and Android version and what you actually saw, including the receiving app and the Conservazione dei dati answer.
items.expected: The actual Android share/save/import round trip preserves the synthetic course. Storage permission is reported honestly, full reset completes without restoring erased data, and the regular app retains its course. No simulated or inferred device PASS.

result.source: Owner chat reports in the Claude Code session of 2026-10-20 on CVC Helper Test 0.4.3.
result.summary: Update 0.4.2 to 0.4.3 offered within about 5 seconds of starting the app; Impostazioni shows 0.4.3. Conservazione dei dati: the browser agreed to keep the app data even when space is low. Prepara then Salva file worked on the first tap. Condividi sent the course file to WhatsApp as a .txt file. Import of the shared or saved file: preview, cancel, then confirmed replacement worked; students, notes, duties and crews checked. Azzera tutti i dati locali finished on its own and the app reopened without a course (import and reset sections shown, which the owner questioned but accepted). Regular app: the owner did not open an installed regular CVC Helper app; opening the regular CVC Helper in Chrome, its data stayed separate from the test app.

result.source: Owner chat report "D4-PHONE-TRANSFER" in the Claude Code session of 2026-10-19.
result.summary: Update 0.4.1 to 0.4.2 worked; a student note typed before the update was kept. Conservazione dei dati said the browser does not guarantee keeping data when space is low and to export regularly. Export: the button needed two taps before anything visible happened (possibly working silently), then it worked and offered to download the file again. Condividi failed with Condivisione non riuscita; the error text is hard to notice (no icon, colour or emphasis). The owner asks to remove the Chiudi il file pronto button. Import preview, cancel, replacement and reopen showed no issue. PROBLEM: Azzera tutti i dati locali took very long or got stuck; after closing and reopening, the app stayed on Apertura del corso… then showed Non riesco ad aprire i dati locali, and Riprova did not fix it; only uninstalling and reinstalling the app recovered it. After reinstalling, importing the saved file worked. Not reported: whether the regular CVC Helper app kept its course. Owner question: importing a different course should replace the current one or say it is not compatible.
result.osVersion: Android, version not stated by the owner

items.title: Check the 0.4.0 release build on Android
instructions: Keep your installed CVC Helper Test (do not reinstall) and use fictitious people only. Open a student and type a note without leaving the screen. Switch away for a minute and come back: time how long Nuova versione disponibile takes to appear (it should be within a minute), then tap Aggiorna at once: the typed note must survive, and Impostazioni must show 0.4.4.
With the phone text size raised, check that the update offer covers neither the + of Allievi nor the Equipaggi controls with a person selected.
Export the course (Salva file and Condividi), import it back after the preview and confirmation, and read Conservazione dei dati.
Report UG3-PHONE-RELEASE with your device, browser and Android version and what you saw.
items.expected: The update arrives without reinstalling and keeps the typed note; controls stay reachable at enlarged text; export, share and import round-trip the synthetic course; storage persistence is reported honestly. Only actual phone observations pass.

result.source: Owner chat recap in the Claude Code session of 2026-10-22 ("i observed everything and all good except" the installation issue below), after OWNER_TODO annotations the same day.
result.summary: The owner reports observing every step and all good: the update arriving without reinstalling with a typed note kept after Aggiorna, the controls reachable at enlarged text (also seen on the earlier 0.4.2 update), export, share and import, and Conservazione dei dati. Individual values (offer time, version shown) were not restated. Exception, not blocking by the owner's judgement: having CVC Helper Test and the regular app installed together is problematic; it worked once, then after problems and reinstalling the regular app, installing the test app says it is already installed although it is not visible (perhaps a failed uninstall or a conflict with the regular app; a phone reboot may fix it). Their data stayed separate.
result.device: Motorola Edge 60 (the owner's phone in earlier reports; not restated)

items.title: Update your regular CVC Helper from 0.3.0 to 0.4.0
instructions: This is your real app with a real course: do not reset or import anything, and report no personal data, only counts and what you saw.

Open the installed regular CVC Helper (not CVC Helper Test). Wait for the 0.3.0 update banner, or close the app completely and reopen it once or twice; note roughly how long the offer took. Apply the update.
Check that the course opens with the same number of students, the duties and today's crews as before, and that Impostazioni shows 0.4.0.
In Impostazioni tap Prepara il file del corso and Salva file to keep a first backup of the real course on the phone. Read Conservazione dei dati.
Report UG3-REGULAR-UPDATE with your device, browser and Android version and what you saw.
items.expected: The installed 0.3.0 app takes 0.4.0 without reinstalling, the real course opens unchanged, Impostazioni shows 0.4.0 and the course can be saved to a file. Only actual phone observations pass.

result.source: Owner chat report in the Claude Code session of 2026-10-22, annotating the UG3-REGULAR-UPDATE item of docs/OWNER_TODO.md.
result.summary: Owner: done and passed, no issue to signal. The installed regular app took 0.4.0 from 0.3.0 without reinstalling and the real course opened; no further detail (offer timing, counts, Conservazione answer, saved file) was given.
result.device: Motorola Edge 60 (the owner's phone in earlier reports; not restated)

Check that Impostazioni shows version 0.4.0 and that your course opens with its students as before.
Report UG3-FINAL-BUILD with what you saw.
items.expected: The regular app runs the final 0.4.0 build with the course intact. Only actual phone observations pass.

items.title: Create the 0.5.0 development backend projects
instructions: Follow docs/working/BACKEND_SETUP_0.5.0.md: a Supabase project cvc-helper-dev in West EU (Ireland), its tables and access rules, the replication role, and a PowerSync Cloud project with a CLI token.
Put each value in the ignored .env file, copied from .env.example; never paste a value into the chat.
Report B2-BACKEND-SETUP with "backend ready", and say whether you prefer the email magic link or another sign-in method.
items.expected: Development projects only, in the EU, with synthetic data; credentials stay in .env. The agent then links, deploys and checks the instance before any app code connects.

result.source: Owner chat reports in the Claude Code session of 2026-10-25 ("backend should be ready", "yes we also have the tables now!", test accounts "done" and "should be fixed now").
result.summary: The owner created the Supabase development project cvc-helper-dev (West EU), ran the course-backup migration (13 tables with row-level security), created powersync_role, created the PowerSync Cloud project CVC Helper with a CLI token, and two synthetic test accounts; all values are in the ignored .env. Chose email magic-link sign-in. The agent verified each value's shape without printing it, linked and deployed the Development instance (EU), and confirmed replication of all 13 tables and both test sign-ins.

items.title: Add the sign-in code to the backend email, with a custom email sender
instructions: Not possible yet: Supabase lets you edit the email only after you set up your own email sender (Authentication > Emails > Set up SMTP). With its built-in sender the email carries just the link.
Nothing to do for the Android check: on Android the link opens in Chrome, which shares the installed app's storage.

Before production (UG4) a custom sender is needed anyway (the built-in one only delivers to your Supabase team and a few emails an hour); add

Codice: {{ .Token }}

to the Magic link template then. Report B3-EMAIL-CODE with "code added" if you do it earlier.
items.expected: Each sign-in email carries both the link and a numeric code, so Impostazioni can sign in where the link opens in another browser (an iPhone home-screen app). Deferred until a custom email sender exists.

items.title: Sign in to the online backup on Android and use it offline
instructions: Open your installed CVC Helper Test (do not reinstall). Switch away and back until Nuova versione disponibile appears, tap Aggiorna, and check Impostazioni shows 0.5.0. Use invented people only: this backup is a development one.

Make sure the test app has a course with two or three invented students. In Impostazioni > Backup online type the email of a test account and tap Invia il link di accesso. Supabase's built-in sender only delivers to the addresses of your Supabase team (your own account email) and a few emails an hour: if your test accounts use other addresses, add a user with your own address in Authentication > Users > Add user. Note whether Link inviato is still there if you close and reopen the app.

On the phone, open the email and tap the link. Note which app opens it (the installed CVC Helper Test, Chrome, or Gmail's own browser) and what Impostazioni then shows. The code field cannot be used yet (B3-EMAIL-CODE).
Once it shows Accesso: <your email>, wait for Copia online aggiornata. While the app reloads once after signing in, try typing a student: report whether anything you typed was lost.

Turn on airplane mode, add a student, close the app completely, reopen it: Impostazioni should show your account and 'In attesa di connessione: 1 modifica da inviare'. Turn airplane mode off and check it reaches Copia online aggiornata without reopening.

With airplane mode on again, change a student, then tap Esci: read the question (it should mention 1 change not yet online), tap Resta collegato, then Esci and Esci. The course must stay on the phone. Optionally the next morning, with airplane mode on, open the app and note what Impostazioni says.
Report B3-PHONE-SIGNIN with your device, browser and Android version and what you actually saw at each step, including which app opened the link and whether the status was readable outdoors.
items.expected: Sign-in by the link (or the code) works on the phone and the backup reaches 'Copia online aggiornata'; offline the account stays signed in and the backup resumes with signal; nothing typed is lost around the one reload; Esci warns about unsent changes and keeps the course. Only your actual phone observations can pass this check.

result.source: Owner chat reports in the Claude Code session of 2026-10-26 on CVC Helper Test 0.5.0 (B3-PHONE-SIGNIN steps 3-7, then 'the Esci question about unsent changes were observed as expected, sign in is fast').
result.summary: Passed with steps not observed. Observed on the phone: the emailed sign-in link opened CVC Helper Test from the mail app (not the installed app nor the browser) and signed in; Copia online aggiornata appeared almost at once; notes and students added, closing and reopening kept them. Airplane mode: 'Tutto inviato. Ora senza connessione.', then after a note 'In attesa di connessione: 2 modifiche da inviare' (still 2 after adding a student), and with signal back the count went 3, 2, 1 to 'Copia online aggiornata' without reopening; closing and reopening worked as expected. The Esci question about unsent changes appeared as expected and the course remained on the phone. Signing in from the mail link and from Chrome showed no difference. Sign-in is fast. NOT OBSERVED: typing a student during the one reload after sign-in (the owner reports sign-in is fast); the installed CVC Helper Test app (the owner used Chrome because the test app cannot be installed beside the regular one, BACKLOG).
result.browser: Chrome (and the mail app's link handling)
result.osVersion: Android, version reported as '1.' (likely 15, as on 2026-10-20)

items.title: Install the B4 build, switch on the server rules, and use the backup offline for a day
instructions: Done (2026-10-27): CVC Helper Test updated to 0.5.1, the upload-rules migration run (verified live: .evidence/B4/live-server-rules.json), and a student or note change reached Copia online aggiornata with no issue.

Then a day of ordinary use offline: turn on airplane mode, make many edits over the day (students, notes, crews, duties, evaluations). Note whether saving ever feels slower than usual, and roughly how many changes Impostazioni says are waiting.

Turn airplane mode off: note how long it takes to reach Copia online aggiornata, and whether any 'Il backup ha rifiutato' message or a note about another phone appears (none is expected with one phone).
Report B4-PHONE-UPLOADS with your device and what you saw at each step.
items.expected: 0.5.1 updates in place and keeps the backup; after the migration the app's writes are accepted; a day of offline edits saves without noticeable slowdown and uploads in full when signal returns, with no refusal. Only your actual phone observations can pass this check.

result.summary: Offline day on 0.5.1: saving as fast as usual with about 150 changes waiting. Airplane mode off: just under 10 s before sending started, about 45 s to send them all, the count decreasing at a steady rate. Throughout and after, Impostazioni showed 'Ora senza connessione' with the warning icon, ending on 'Tutto inviato. Ora senza connessione', although the phone was online and everything was sent; closing and reopening the app showed 'Copia online aggiornata'. Only one copy of the app was open.

items.title: Let the app read the server's minimum app version
instructions: In the Supabase dashboard of cvc-helper-dev open SQL Editor, then New query.

Paste the whole file supabase/migrations/20261027000000_minimum_writer_read.sql from the project folder and Run it once; it should report success with no rows. It is safe to run now: only the coming 0.5.2 build calls it.
Write 'minimum read run' in the chat; I then run the live check that a restored course reads the minimum.
items.expected: A signed-in account can read the minimum writer version and nothing else; a restored course adopts it, so an app older than it opens the course read-only.

result.source: Chat, 2026-10-28: '1.2 done, 1.3 done - minimum read run, erase rules run'
result.summary: The owner ran the migration in the SQL Editor of cvc-helper-dev; the agent's live checks afterwards are in the milestone's evidence.

items.title: Restore your course on an emptied phone, and see the question for another course
instructions: Open CVC Helper Test in Chrome (do not reinstall). Switch away and back until Nuova versione disponibile appears, tap Aggiorna, and check Impostazioni shows 0.5.2 and Copia online aggiornata. Note how many students and notes your invented course has.
Impostazioni > Azzera tutti i dati locali, and confirm. The app reopens empty, on Crea il corso.

On that screen, under Ripristina dal backup online, type your email and send the link; open it from the mail as before. Note what the screen says while it downloads (it should say Ripristino del corso… and keep Crea corso disabled), and how long until the app reopens on your course.
Check the restored course: the same students, notes, crews and evaluations as before; then edit something and see Copia online aggiornata.

Optional, on the PC: open the test address in Chrome, create a different invented course there, then in its Impostazioni sign in with the same email. It should ask, naming your online course, before replacing anything; tap Annulla ed esci and check the PC course stays.
Report B5-PHONE-RESTORE with what you saw at each step, and which you skipped.
items.expected: An emptied phone restores the course in full from the backup and reopens on it; nothing can be created meanwhile; a device with another course asks before replacing it. Only your actual observations can pass this check.

items.title: Let the server keep an erased course erased
instructions: In the Supabase dashboard of cvc-helper-dev open SQL Editor, then New query.

Paste the whole file supabase/migrations/20261028000000_course_erase.sql from the project folder and Run it once; it should report success with no rows. It is safe to run now: the installed builds never touch it, and the B6 build erases courses with or without it.
Write 'erase rules run' in the chat; I then run the live check that an erased course refuses a later upload from another phone.
items.expected: The server records the ids of erased courses (no course data, readable only by their owner) and refuses that course from any phone afterwards.

result.source: Chat, 2026-10-28: '1.2 done, 1.3 done - minimum read run, erase rules run'
result.summary: The owner ran the migration in the SQL Editor of cvc-helper-dev; the agent's live checks afterwards are in the milestone's evidence.

items.title: Erase your course on the phone, once offline, and see it gone from the backup
instructions: Only after B4-PHONE-UPLOADS and B5-PHONE-RESTORE are reported: they need the course on the backup. The build, its address and the exact steps follow here when it is published.
items.expected: Erasing the course on the phone erases it from the backup, also when the erase was made offline and the phone reconnected later; the erased course never comes back. Only your actual observations can pass this check.
